scope.purpose: Show a set of records in rows and columns so that values can be read and compared, as a native semantic data table.
useCases: A list of invoices, users or orders with a few columns, numbers aligned at the end.
Rich cells: a Badge for a status, a Link to the record, an Avatar with a name, a Menu of row actions.
A totals row in the footer.
A wide table that scrolls inline on a narrow screen; a table of limited height whose header stays visible.
exclusions: Sorting, row selection, expandable rows, column resizing or reordering, virtualization, inline editing: separately scoped enhancements (catalog), toward a later DataGrid.
Pagination inside the table: composed below with Pagination.
Loading state: composed with Skeleton rows.
Row hover and clickable rows in v1.
alternatives: DataField for the properties of a single record.
A list for items made of several lines of text.
DataGrid (later) for editing and large data sets.

fixtures: Badge, Link, Avatar, Menu and Pagination in the examples (content and composition, not dependencies).

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Compound contract with children header, body, footer, row, heading (column header cell) and cell, so that cells hold free content (the semantic table of the catalog); no records API in v1 (row fields are not known in advance).
Header band in color.surface.subtle with a line in color.border.default; lines between body rows in color.border.subtle; no outer frame (the integration places the table in a card when it wants one).
Headers in typography.label.md and color.content.secondary; cells in typography.body.sm with tabular figures; the typography does not change with size or density.
size sm, md, lg sets the minimum row height (size.control.{size}: 32, 40, 48 px in standard density); cells center one line and keep that block padding when they wrap.
Cell inline padding space.content.md (12 px in standard).
Visible caption by default (typography.heading.xs), hideCaption when a heading next to the table already names it; caption is required as the accessible name.

Inline overflow scrolls in the table's own area, which becomes a focus stop named by the caption only while it overflows; the header sticks to the top of that area when the integration limits its height.
A cell with rowHeader is exposed as the header of its row and looks like the other cells.
